status.description: Overall verdict for the PR as it stands now, set by the most severe finding still open: red = blocking, orange = should fix, yellow = nits only, green = nothing left.

summary.description: The review summary in Markdown, in the shape review.md prescribes, without the automated-review footer.

inline.description: Findings tied to a line. Empty when there are none.

path.description: Repository-relative path of a file the PR changes, e.g. Sources/AetherEngine/AetherEngine.swift.

line.description: Line number in the PR head version of the file; must be a line inside the diff.

body.description: One finding: what is wrong, the scenario where it breaks, and a fix when there is one.
